title: Trial queued heads at once on stacked tips and land them in order
description: The real loop's merge writer step trials three queue positions at once, the second on the first's merge commit and the third on the second's, and pushes them in queue order onto the tips they were trialled on. When the second fails, the first lands, the second is refused to rework, and the third is trialled again on the tip without the second before it lands.

steps.name: stacked trials land in order and a failure re-trials only the positions stacked on it
